description: Full-text search over the Slovak fishing portal: fishing waters ("revír"), rivers and lakes ("tok"), river basins ("povodie"), fish species, wildlife, guides, local SRZ organisations and competitions. Returns titles, URLs and short details; content is in Slovak. Diacritics are optional in the query.

type.description: Optional result type filter: rev = fishing water, tok = river/lake, pov = river basin, fish = fish species, bio = wildlife and plants, guide = guide, mo = SRZ organisation, comp = competition, hub = waters by region, znec = water quality, disc = discoveries, post = article, page = other page.
